table.name: Other_Available_Features
table.purpose: Lookup/catalog of optional property features (e.g. air conditioning, swimming pool, burglar alarm), each classified by feature type (Amenity or Security). Referenced by Other_Property_Features to record which features a property has.

feature_description.name: feature_description
feature_description.description: Human-readable description of the feature, e.g. 'Air Conditioning.', 'Swimming Pool.', 'Burglar Alarm'.

feature_id.name: feature_id
feature_id.description: Primary key; unique numeric identifier of the feature. Referenced by Other_Property_Features.feature_id.

feature_name.name: feature_name
feature_name.description: Short camelCase code/label for the feature, e.g. 'AirCon', 'Pool', 'BurglarAlarm'.

feature_type_code.name: feature_type_code
feature_type_code.description: Foreign key to Ref_Feature_Types.feature_type_code; classifies the feature as 'Amenity' (e.g. Pool) or 'Security' (e.g. Burglar Alarm).

table.name: Other_Property_Features
table.purpose: Junction table linking properties to their optional features: each row records one feature (from Other_Available_Features) attached to one property (from Properties), with a free-text note.

feature_id.name: feature_id
feature_id.description: Foreign key to Other_Available_Features.feature_id; identifies which feature (2=Air Conditioning, 3=Swimming Pool, 4=Burglar Alarm) this row records.

property_feature_description.name: property_feature_description
property_feature_description.description: Free-text note/comment about the feature for this property. Values are placeholder Latin words (lorem-ipsum style), so the real content is dummy data; the column's semantic role is a per-property feature description. Alternative reading: it could be a general remarks field for the property-feature row rather than a description of the feature itself.

property_id.name: property_id
property_id.description: Foreign key to Properties.property_id; the property that has this feature.

table.name: Properties
table.purpose: Core real-estate listing table: one row per property with its name, address, type, room count, marketing/sale dates and prices, plus per-type feature columns (most of which are empty).

agreed_selling_price.name: agreed_selling_price
agreed_selling_price.description: Final agreed sale price of the property (numeric stored in a union type; values range from 0 to ~244 million, currency unit unknown).

apt_feature_1.name: apt_feature_1
apt_feature_1.description: First apartment-specific feature attribute; the 'apt' prefix matches the 'Apartment' property type code. Values are placeholder Latin words, so the concrete meaning is unclear; likely a feature description/flag applying to Apartment-type properties. Alternative reading: a generic per-type attribute unrelated to features.

apt_feature_2.name: apt_feature_2
apt_feature_2.description: Second apartment-specific feature attribute; 'apt' prefix matches the 'Apartment' property type code. Placeholder Latin text, likely a feature description/flag for Apartment-type properties. Alternative reading: a generic per-type attribute unrelated to features.

apt_feature_3.name: apt_feature_3
apt_feature_3.description: Third apartment-specific feature attribute; 'apt' prefix matches the 'Apartment' property type code. Boolean role suggests a yes/no feature flag for Apartment-type properties, but no join or value evidence confirms which feature it denotes.

buyer_offered_price.name: buyer_offered_price
buyer_offered_price.description: Price offered by the buyer (numeric stored in a union type; ranges from 0 to ~14 million, currency unit unknown).

date_on_market.name: date_on_market
date_on_market.description: Date (with time) the property was listed/placed on the market; range 1976-06-10 to 2017-09-14.

date_sold.name: date_sold
date_sold.description: Date (with time) the property was sold; range 1971-04-14 to 2012-08-19.

fld_feature_1.name: fld_feature_1
fld_feature_1.description: First field-specific feature attribute; 'fld' prefix matches the 'Field' property type code. Boolean role suggests a yes/no feature flag for Field-type properties, but no join or value evidence confirms which feature it denotes.

fld_feature_2.name: fld_feature_2
fld_feature_2.description: Second field-specific feature attribute; 'fld' prefix matches the 'Field' property type code. Boolean role suggests a yes/no feature flag for Field-type properties, but no join or value evidence confirms which feature it denotes.

fld_feature_3.name: fld_feature_3
fld_feature_3.description: Third field-specific feature attribute; 'fld' prefix matches the 'Field' property type code. Boolean role suggests a yes/no feature flag for Field-type properties, but no join or value evidence confirms which feature it denotes.

hse_feature_1.name: hse_feature_1
hse_feature_1.description: First house-specific feature attribute; 'hse' prefix matches the 'House' property type code. Boolean role suggests a yes/no feature flag for House-type properties, but no join or value evidence confirms which feature it denotes.

hse_feature_2.name: hse_feature_2
hse_feature_2.description: Second house-specific feature attribute; 'hse' prefix matches the 'House' property type code. Boolean role suggests a yes/no feature flag for House-type properties, but no join or value evidence confirms which feature it denotes.

hse_feature_3.name: hse_feature_3
hse_feature_3.description: Third house-specific feature attribute; 'hse' prefix matches the 'House' property type code. Boolean role suggests a yes/no feature flag for House-type properties, but no join or value evidence confirms which feature it denotes.

oth_feature_1.name: oth_feature_1
oth_feature_1.description: First feature attribute for 'Other'-type properties; 'oth' prefix matches the 'Other' property type code. Boolean role suggests a yes/no feature flag, but no join or value evidence confirms which feature it denotes.

oth_feature_2.name: oth_feature_2
oth_feature_2.description: Second feature attribute for 'Other'-type properties; 'oth' prefix matches the 'Other' property type code. Boolean role suggests a yes/no feature flag, but no join or value evidence confirms which feature it denotes.

oth_feature_3.name: oth_feature_3
oth_feature_3.description: Third feature attribute for 'Other'-type properties; 'oth' prefix matches the 'Other' property type code. Boolean role suggests a yes/no feature flag, but no join or value evidence confirms which feature it denotes.

property_address.name: property_address
property_address.description: Full postal address of the property (street/unit line plus city, state and ZIP), unique per row.

property_id.name: property_id
property_id.description: Primary key; unique numeric identifier of the property. Referenced by Other_Property_Features.property_id.

property_name.name: property_name
property_name.description: Name/label of the property (e.g. 'avalon', 'the cole', 'riverside'), unique per row.

property_type_code.name: property_type_code
property_type_code.description: Foreign key to Ref_Property_Types.property_type_code; the property's type: House, Apartment, Field, Shop or Other.

room_count.name: room_count
room_count.description: Number of rooms in the property; integer 1-9.

shp_feature_1.name: shp_feature_1
shp_feature_1.description: First shop-specific feature attribute; 'shp' prefix matches the 'Shop' property type code. Boolean role suggests a yes/no feature flag for Shop-type properties, but no join or value evidence confirms which feature it denotes.

shp_feature_2.name: shp_feature_2
shp_feature_2.description: Second shop-specific feature attribute; 'shp' prefix matches the 'Shop' property type code. Boolean role suggests a yes/no feature flag for Shop-type properties, but no join or value evidence confirms which feature it denotes.

shp_feature_3.name: shp_feature_3
shp_feature_3.description: Third shop-specific feature attribute; 'shp' prefix matches the 'Shop' property type code. Boolean role suggests a yes/no feature flag for Shop-type properties, but no join or value evidence confirms which feature it denotes.

vendor_requested_price.name: vendor_requested_price
vendor_requested_price.description: Asking price requested by the vendor/seller (numeric stored in a union type; ranges from ~79 to ~661 million, currency unit unknown).

table.name: Ref_Feature_Types
table.purpose: Reference/lookup table of feature type codes (Amenity, Security) with their descriptions, used to classify features in Other_Available_Features.

feature_type_code.name: feature_type_code
feature_type_code.description: Primary key; feature type code ('Amenity' or 'Security'). Referenced by Other_Available_Features.feature_type_code.

feature_type_name.name: feature_type_name
feature_type_name.description: Description of the feature type, e.g. 'Amenity, eg Pool.', 'Securiyt, eg Burglar Alarm.' (note the typo 'Securiyt' in the data).

table.name: Ref_Property_Types
table.purpose: Reference/lookup table of property type codes (House, Apartment, Field, Shop, Other) with their descriptions, used to classify properties in Properties.

property_type_code.name: property_type_code
property_type_code.description: Primary key; property type code ('House', 'Apartment', 'Field', 'Shop', 'Other'). Referenced by Properties.property_type_code.

property_type_description.name: property_type_description
property_type_description.description: Description of the property type, e.g. 'House, Bungalow, etc.', 'Apartment, Flat, Condo, etc.', 'Field, Meadow.', 'Shop, Retail Outlet.', 'Other, to be determined.'
